exposure: prior loop electrosurgical excision procedure or cold knife cone biopsy
cohort: Adult patients who underwent office endometrial biopsy in 2023 across a large health system.
finding: Postmenopausal status, leiomyomas, history of cesarean delivery, chronic pain, and anxiety were associated with a higher risk of insufficient endometrial biopsies, whereas a BMI of 50 or higher was associated with a decreased risk.
mod_finding: History of cesarean delivery was associated with insufficient endometrial biopsy in premenopausal patients.
